The Shi'a view Ali ibn Husayn as the rightful heir to the Islamic caliphate and the rightful successor to the Prophet Muhammad. The Shi'a path is based on the direct lineage of Ali ibn Husayn to the Prophet Muhammad and to his direct followers, including the founding members of the Islamic state (Sultanate of Medina) and the first caliphs.
